moss-local voice-acting — best-of-64 by emotion (pilot)

What this is (for dummies). the same pilot we ran on MOSS-8B (delay architecture), repeated on TTS-AGI/moss-local-transformer-voice-acting: MOSS-TTS-Local (4.55B, 12-codebook RVQ @ 48 kHz, v2 tokenizer), full dramabox fine-tune + rank-256 voice-acting LoRA (checkpoint-1m, merged into the weights). identical 10 groups: 5 emotions × 2 prompts from laion/voice-acting-prompts, procedural instructions, 64 takes each, batched inference.

Ranking: reward = invWER × ( 1.5·norm(target emotion) + norm(genuineness) + norm(vocal-burst blend) ) — top-3 of 64 below. scores from Empathic-Insight-Voice-Plus + VoiceCLAP + Parakeet WER.

head-to-head: moss-local (48 kHz) vs MOSS-8B delay (24 kHz), same 10 groups
